title: Classic-only observation on a clear straight (Rookie)
description: One 5 Hz observation for a Classic-only participant at Rookie difficulty on a clear 10 m straight (top speed 65 m/s, usable half-width 5.0 m). Style is 'none', so both style one-hot inputs are 0/0 while the rule personality remains explicit configuration (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1'). No neighbor is present: all four neighbor slots are absent and fully zeroed, and the corridor-occupancy fractions are 0. History is valid with no recent pass attempt (pass side 0, attempt age saturated at the 3 s clip). traffic_age_ticks is the Rookie default 18 (sampled_tick 500, traffic_snapshot_tick 482). Status 'provisional'.

expectations.statement: Record difficulty, style and participant_id match the fixture context; Classic-only style is 'none'.
Exactly one difficulty one-hot is set and it is Rookie (index 57).
Classic-only style leaves both style one-hot inputs at 0/0.
No neighbor is present; all four slots are absent and fully zeroed and masks.neighbor_slots is all zero.
With no present neighbors the ascending-gap ordering is vacuous.
Rookie difficulty uses the 18-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
With history_valid 1 the discrete history fields stay in range and the magnitudes are non-negative.
The raw_inputs probes normalize to the recorded values (speed/top-speed, surge cooldown/2 s, grade/0.12, forward distance/195 m).
No safe diagnostic fallback is active.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.

Every raw_inputs key is a canonical feature-index string naming each index at most once, so an aliased key (e.g. '027' for 27) cannot satisfy one check while bypassing another that looks the index up canonically.
Every declared metric is a documented initial target or an explicit undecided requirement; no fixture metric claims a measured status.
Each metric's bound members match its comparator: threshold comparators carry a numeric value, range/ratio_range carry ordered value_min/value_max, report carries no bound.

unknowns.reason: The 'planned encounter' distance for corridor occupancy is not fixed by OPPONENT_AI.md.
Placeholder only: no ObservationBuilder revision is ratified until M4.2 implements the shared interface.
The current-vs-delayed split inside the history group is an interpretation of OPPONENT_AI.md and must be confirmed when demonstrations are collected.

The usable-half-width convention is unratified and blocks dependent work: OPPONENT_AI.md normalizes feature 4 (lane offset) by the 'usable half-width' and divides history lane targets 51-52 'by its then-usable half-width' without defining the quantity, while its action-0 decode derives the narrower legal corridor (road_width - car_width)/2 - 0.5 m. The authored value here is road_width/2 (10 m section, 5.0 m half-width) as an illustrative value only The convention (road half-width versus the action-0 legal-corridor half-width) must be ratified before demonstrations are collected; this slice records the ambiguity and does not decide it.
